title: Circit Connector Manifest
description: Canonical, vendored contract describing a sandbox connector (data source / tool surface). Source of truth lives in the cowork repo /contracts; Odysseus vendors a byte-identical copy under its own /contracts. The 2.5 admission gate in BOTH backends keys its fail-closed decision off `dataClass`.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest contract version. Pinned so a backend can refuse a manifest it does not understand (fail-closed).

id.description: Stable connector identifier, referenced by audit events (dataSourceId).

dataClass.description: Sensitivity tier of the data this connector exposes. Default to the most restrictive (banking) when absent so an omitted field cannot widen access. The 2.5 gate refuses boot when SANDBOX_MODE != isolated and any enabled connector is NOT synthetic.

enabled.description: Whether this connector is active in the running deployment. Disabled connectors are excluded from the 2.5 admission check.

untrustedOutput.description: Whether output from this connector must be wrapped before model re-ingestion. Fail-closed default is true.

egress.description: Outbound network policy for sandbox runs that use this connector. Deny-by-default; only the listed hosts are reachable, and every entry is still subnet-checked against url_security._BLOCKED_NETWORKS at runtime (2.2).

allowedHosts.description: Host or host:port entries permitted when mode=allowlist. RFC-1918 / IMDS / loopback targets are rejected at runtime regardless of inclusion here.

dualControl.description: P3 connector layer attaches approver requirements here. Present in the v1 contract so P3 does not need a schema bump.
